title: Fix demo rerun session id collision after PR rebase
description: During rebase of PR 25 onto origin/main, npm run test failed in packages/cli/test/play.test.ts: runDemo > reuses an existing demo campaign on a later run. Symptom: SessionError session 'session-2' already exists in campaign 'campaign-1'. Investigate whether the rebase integration introduced or exposed a demo rerun id-generation bug, then fix with verification. Parent context: loreweaver-d4r.
acceptance_criteria: Root cause is recorded; an automated test covers demo rerun without duplicate session ids; npm run typecheck and npm run test pass after the fix.
notes:
Evidence: after rebasing PR 25 onto origin/main, npm run test fails reproducibly in packages/cli/test/play.test.ts runDemo > reuses an existing demo campaign on a later run. Stack points to packages/cli/src/play.ts:149 createDemoCampaign, then core startSession rejects duplicate session 'session-2' in campaign 'campaign-1'. Recent change on main added runDemo and a test using baseDeps() twice; baseDeps resets deterministic IDs for each call, so a second demo run can generate IDs already used by the first run.
Pattern analysis: runPlay/runDemo expect PlayDeps.nextId to produce unique ids within the target DB. Production buildPlayDeps uses timestamp plus randomness, but packages/cli/test/play.test.ts baseDeps starts ids at 0 for each call. The failing demo rerun test uses a new baseDeps against the same in-memory DB, so the second run can reuse closed-session ids from the first run. Working pattern is to keep one ID source for multiple invocations against the same DB, or otherwise seed a unique offset.
Hypothesis: the implementation path is valid; the failing test fixture violates the nextId uniqueness contract by resetting the deterministic ID generator between demo runs against the same DB. Minimal test: reuse the same PlayDeps/id source for both runDemo calls while swapping the IO object for the second run. Expected result: second run takes the existing-campaign branch and starts a unique later session.
Result: changed packages/cli/test/play.test.ts demo rerun test to reuse the same PlayDeps/id source while swapping only IO for the second run. Targeted verification npm run test -- packages/cli/test/play.test.ts passed with 12 tests. Full verification npm run typecheck passed; npm run test passed with 35 files passed / 1 skipped and 223 tests passed / 1 skipped.
close_reason: Root cause was a test fixture resetting deterministic IDs across two demo runs against one DB; fixed the fixture to reuse the same ID source. Verification: npm run typecheck and npm run test passed.
